note: Phase-1 (powers of tau) files accepted by `ceremony.mjs init` outside --synthetic-test-only. A file is accepted only when its Blake2b-512 digest equals an entry here. Adding an entry is a security review decision: record where the digest was independently published and who checked it. `candidates` are NOT accepted; they are recorded so reviewers can promote them.

sources.provenance: Hermez/Polygon phase-1 ceremony (54 contributions plus beacon). Digest as published in the snarkjs README; already pinned by zk/scripts/build-test-fixture.mjs.

candidates.provenance: PSE Perpetual Powers of Tau, contribution 80, truncated to 2^14 and prepared for phase 2. Digest OBSERVED by Attest on 2026-11-22 after downloading the file; it was not copied from an independently published checksum, and `snarkjs powersoftau verify` did not finish within a 10-minute local budget. NOT ACCEPTED for CEREMONY mode until both checks are done and this entry is moved to `sources` in a reviewed change.
